headline: Guatemala begins distribution and use of ethanol-blended gasoline at more than 2,000 gas stations nationwide
summary: A new phase begins in Guatemala as ethanol-blended gasoline reaches more than 2,000 gas stations nationwide. The rollout will gradually extend to the country's stations.
why: Ethanol blending in gasoline links fuel demand to agricultural feedstock such as sugarcane and affects fuel import needs.

original_headline: Guatemala comienza la distribución y uso de gasolina con etanol en más de 2 mil gasolineras a nivel nacional
